chapters.title: Security under pressure
chapters.description: A second walkthrough tests denied access, offline alerts and a blocked bolt.

chapters.title: Wrong role rejected
chapters.description: An owner code cannot be used for a courier request.

chapters.title: Expired token rejected
chapters.description: The controller checks expiry using simulated time.

chapters.title: The message link goes offline
chapters.description: Event detection continues while outbound delivery is paused.

chapters.title: Three impacts. Three alerts.
chapters.description: Each detected impact gets an ID and remains in the outbox.

chapters.title: Recovery without duplicates
chapters.description: The simulated endpoint acknowledges every queued event ID once.

chapters.title: A lost ACK triggers retry
chapters.description: Duplicate packets are deduplicated by the endpoint.

chapters.title: Approved access opens the box
chapters.description: Measured bolt travel is confirmed before the door moves.

chapters.title: The bolt is physically disabled
chapters.description: Available motor force is set to zero while the locking target remains commanded.

chapters.title: Fault. Never falsely secured.
chapters.description: A two-second timeout exposes the failed bolt position.

chapters.title: Measured recovery
chapters.description: Force is restored. The fault clears only after the bolt reaches its target.
